title: Robert B. and Candice J. Haas Visiting Professor in Corporate Finance Law
bio: Bala Dharan is Robert B. and Candice J. Haas Visiting Professor in Corporate Finance Law and Senior Lecturer at Harvard Law School. He has been teaching at HLS since 2008. Professor Dharan is also J. Howard Creekmore Professor Emeritus at the Jones Graduate School of Business at Rice University, a Visiting Professor at MIT Sloan […]
